display.purpose: Now-playing song title on the host screen. The single largest, glow-paired text in the system.

headline.purpose: Page-level headings on the guest flow (e.g. 'Entre na sala').

title.purpose: Secondary state headings, e.g. host screen's empty/waiting state.

body.purpose: Supporting text — singer names, hint copy, queue metadata.

label.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked kickers and form labels. The system's one recurring eyebrow style — used only for genuine labels.

shadows.name: glow-pink
shadows.purpose: Applied to the primary/live song title. Signals 'this is live/primary.'

shadows.name: glow-cyan
shadows.purpose: Applied to artist names and status/hint text. Signals 'this is status/secondary.'

shadows.name: border-glow-pink
shadows.value: border: 1px solid rgba(255,0,127,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,127,0.2), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,127,0.05)
shadows.purpose: The only shadow-like value on a container — a glow standing in for elevation, never a drop shadow.

shadows.name: border-glow-cyan
shadows.value: border: 1px solid rgba(0,240,255,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,0.2), inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,240,255,0.05)
shadows.purpose: Cyan variant of the border-glow, for secondary/status-active containers.

motion.name: transition-color
motion.purpose: Default hover/focus transition on buttons and inputs — color-only, no movement.

motion.name: transition-progress
motion.purpose: Progress-bar fill advances smoothly as the song plays.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width join/submit CTA. Muted plum-to-maroon gradient, deliberately calmer than the neon accents.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); background: linear-gradient(to right, #2A0A3E, #3D0A2A); border: 1px solid rgba(255,0,127,0.3); transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(255,0,127,0.7); color: #FFFFFF; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Panel-colored secondary action, e.g. the host screen's 'Próxima' control or the mode-select links.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { padding: 8px 20px; border-radius: 12px; background: #130924; border: 1px solid rgba(126,110,155,0.3); color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(255,0,127,0.5); color: #FF007F; outline: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Join-flow name/room-code field. Panel background, pink low-opacity border, border brightens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #130924; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,0,127,0.2); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(126,110,155,0.5); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(255,0,127,0.6); outline: none; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Room-code badge in the host navbar — black pill with a neon-pink border-glow.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #000000; color: #FF007F; font-family: 'Inter', 'Poppins', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.15em; border: 1px solid rgba(255,0,127,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,127,0.2), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,127,0.05); }

narrative.overview: Videoké takes the neon lighting rig of a real karaoke venue and installs it in someone's living room. The palette is the same deep-purple-black and pink/cyan glow you'd find in a proper show, but the tone stays domestic and playful — this is friends passing a phone around, not a nightclub console. Glow is the string-lights-and-spotlights of the party, never a mood the copy or interactions need to match. The system explicitly rejects the generic-karaoke-app look: no cheap bordered lists, no default form-library styling, no stock microphone clip-art. It also stays out of corporate-SaaS territory — no dashboard card-grids, no admin-tool chrome. Every surface is either the show (host screen) or the invite (guest phone flow), never a settings page.
keyCharacteristics: Deep near-black purple as the base, never a neutral gray or white canvas.
Two-color neon signal system: pink for primary/active/singing-now, cyan for status/secondary info.
Text glow (text-shadow) substitutes for elevation — depth comes from light, not shadow.
Heavy, geometric sans throughout; no serif, no script.
Generous corner rounding (8–12px) and pill shapes for anything touchable.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only pink and cyan carry meaning. Pink = primary/active/live-now. Cyan = status/secondary/connected. Never swap their roles, never introduce a third signal color.

rules.name: The No-True-Neutral Rule
rules.body: There is no plain gray or plain white-on-dark in this system. Every 'neutral' (Dim, Panel, Void, Sidebar Void) carries the same purple hue at a different depth. A gray that doesn't lean purple is a bug, not a shortcut.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are always 900 (black) or nothing close to it — no medium-weight headlines. If it's a heading, it's the heaviest weight in the stack.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add a conventional dark drop-shadow to imply elevation. If something needs to feel 'lifted,' lighten its background one step (Void → Panel) or give it a border-glow, never a black shadow.

dos: Do keep every background a step on the purple-black ramp (Void → Sidebar Void → Panel) — never introduce a true gray or white surface.
Do use text-glow and border-glow as the only 'elevation' — a lighter background step is the fallback when glow isn't appropriate.
Do keep primary actions on the muted plum-to-maroon gradient, reserving full-saturation neon pink for live/active state, not button fills.
Do keep labels/kickers uppercase and wide-tracked, but only on genuine labels (form fields, section headers like 'FILA') — not decoratively above every section.
Do keep the tone playful and domestic in copy and motion even though the palette is venue-grade neon — this is a house party, not a nightclub console.
donts: Don't build generic-karaoke-app UI: bordered list rows, default form-library styling, stock microphone clip-art. That's the explicit anti-reference.
Don't drift toward corporate SaaS: no dashboard card-grids, no admin-tool chrome, no settings-page density.
Don't add conventional dark drop-shadows anywhere; this system has no shadow-based elevation.
Don't introduce a third accent color. Pink and cyan are the only signal colors — anything else (green/red for votes) stays a narrow, literal exception, never a new brand color.
Don't use a plain gray. If something needs to be muted, it's Dim (#7E6E9B) or a low-opacity version of an existing token, always purple-tinted.
Don't let the mood tip nightclub-serious — no cold, austere, console-like styling; warmth comes through in copy, pacing, and rounded, tactile shapes, not just color.
